subject: Maths
question: Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their sum is 168. What is their HCF?
solution: The numbers are 2k and 5k; 2 and 5 are co-prime, so the HCF is k. 7k = 168 gives k = 24: the numbers are 48 and 120, HCF 24.
questionHi: दो संख्याएँ 2 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं और उनका योग 168 है। उनका HCF क्या है?
solutionHi: संख्याएँ 2k और 5k हैं; 2 और 5 सह-अभाज्य हैं, अतः HCF = k। 7k = 168 से k = 24: संख्याएँ 48 और 120, HCF 24।

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest number that is exactly divisible by each of 4, 11 and 25?
solution: The smallest number divisible by each is their LCM. 4 = 2², 11 = 11, 25 = 5². Take every prime with its highest power: 2² × 5² × 11 = 1100. So the number is 1100.
questionHi: वह सबसे छोटी संख्या कौन-सी है जो 4, 11 और 25 में से प्रत्येक से पूरी तरह विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: प्रत्येक से विभाज्य सबसे छोटी संख्या उनका LCM है। 4 = 2², 11 = 11, 25 = 5²। हर अभाज्य उसकी सबसे बड़ी घात के साथ: 2² × 5² × 11 = 1100। अतः संख्या = 1100।

subject: Maths
question: Find the HCF of 1.44 and 1.62.
solution: Write them in hundredths: 144, 162. HCF(144, 162) = 18, so the HCF is 18 hundredths = 0.18.
questionHi: 1.44 और 1.62 का HCF ज्ञात कीजिए।

subject: Maths
question: Which of the following numbers is co-prime to 76?
solution: Two numbers are co-prime when their HCF is 1. 76 = 2² × 19. 80 shares 4, 82 shares 2, 78 shares 2; 81 = 3⁴ shares no prime with 76, so HCF(76, 81) = 1.
questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी संख्या 76 के साथ सह-अभाज्य (co-prime) है?
solutionHi: दो संख्याएँ सह-अभाज्य होती हैं जब उनका HCF 1 हो। 76 = 2² × 19। 80 में 4 उभयनिष्ठ है, 82 में 2 उभयनिष्ठ है, 78 में 2 उभयनिष्ठ है; 81 = 3⁴ में 76 का कोई अभाज्य नहीं, अतः HCF(76, 81) = 1।

subject: Maths
question: What is the LCM of 3⁴ × 5 and 3 × 5 × 11?
solution: Take every prime that appears in either, each with its higher power: 3⁴ × 5 × 11 = 4455.
questionHi: 3⁴ × 5 और 3 × 5 × 11 का LCM क्या है?
solutionHi: किसी में भी आने वाला हर अभाज्य, अपनी बड़ी घात के साथ: 3⁴ × 5 × 11 = 4455।

subject: Maths
question: A room is 475 cm long and 437 cm wide. Its floor is to be covered with square tiles, all of the same size, without cutting any tile. What is the least number of tiles needed?
solution: Fewest tiles means the largest tile: HCF(475, 437) = 19 cm. Tiles = (475 ÷ 19) × (437 ÷ 19) = 25 × 23 = 575.
questionHi: एक कमरा 475 cm लंबा और 437 cm चौड़ा है। इसके फ़र्श पर एक ही आकार की वर्गाकार टाइलें बिना काटे लगानी हैं। कम से कम कितनी टाइलें लगेंगी?

subject: Maths
question: What is the least number that must be subtracted from 14098 so that the result is exactly divisible by 10, 14 and 15?
solution: A number divisible by 10, 14 and 15 is a multiple of their LCM, 210. 14098 ÷ 210 leaves 28, so take away 28 to reach 14070.
questionHi: 14098 में से कम से कम कौन-सी संख्या घटाई जाए कि शेष 10, 14 और 15 से पूरी तरह विभाज्य हो जाए?
solutionHi: 10, 14 और 15 से विभाज्य संख्या उनके LCM 210 की गुणज है। 14098 ÷ 210 का शेषफल 28, अतः 28 घटाने पर 14070।

subject: Maths
question: What is the LCM of 13, 30 and 45?
solution: 13 = 13, 30 = 2 × 3 × 5, 45 = 3² × 5. Take every prime with its highest power: 2 × 3² × 5 × 13 = 1170. So the LCM is 1170.
questionHi: 13, 30 और 45 का LCM ज्ञात कीजिए।

subject: Maths
question: Find the LCM of 0.5 and 1.2.
solution: Write them in tenths: 5, 12. LCM(5, 12) = 60, so the LCM is 60 tenths = 6.
questionHi: 0.5 और 1.2 का LCM ज्ञात कीजिए।

subject: Maths
question: Three lights flash at intervals of 8, 12 and 27 seconds respectively. If they flash together now, after how many seconds will they next flash together?
solution: They are together again after a time that is a multiple of every interval - the least is the LCM. 8 = 2³, 12 = 2² × 3, 27 = 3³, so LCM(8, 12, 27) = 216 seconds.
questionHi: तीन बत्तियाँ क्रमशः 8, 12 और 27 सेकंड के अंतराल पर चमकती हैं। यदि वे अभी एक साथ चमकती हैं, तो कितने सेकंड बाद वे फिर एक साथ चमकेंगी?
solutionHi: वे फिर उस समय साथ होंगी जो हर अंतराल का गुणज हो - सबसे कम LCM है। 8 = 2³, 12 = 2² × 3, 27 = 3³, अतः LCM(8, 12, 27) = 216 सेकंड।

subject: Maths
question: Find the HCF of 132 and 154.
solution: 132 = 2² × 3 × 11, 154 = 2 × 7 × 11. The common prime factors, each with its lower power: 2 × 11 = 22. So the HCF is 22.
questionHi: 132 और 154 का HCF (महत्तम समापवर्तक) क्या है?
solutionHi: 132 = 2² × 3 × 11, 154 = 2 × 7 × 11। उभयनिष्ठ अभाज्य गुणनखंड, प्रत्येक अपनी छोटी घात के साथ: 2 × 11 = 22। अतः HCF = 22।

subject: Maths
question: Two numbers are in the ratio 1 : 9 and their difference is 104. What is their HCF?
solution: The numbers are 1k and 9k with HCF k (1 and 9 are co-prime). 8k = 104 gives k = 13: the numbers are 13 and 117, HCF 13.
questionHi: दो संख्याएँ 1 : 9 के अनुपात में हैं और उनका अंतर 104 है। उनका HCF क्या है?
solutionHi: संख्याएँ 1k और 9k हैं, HCF = k (1 और 9 सह-अभाज्य हैं)। 8k = 104 से k = 13: संख्याएँ 13 और 117, HCF 13।

subject: Maths
question: What is the least length of cloth that can be measured exactly by any of three rods of 23 cm, 26 cm and 39 cm?
solution: The length must be a whole number of each: the least is LCM(23, 26, 39) = 1794 cm (17 m 94 cm).
questionHi: कपड़े की वह न्यूनतम लंबाई क्या है जिसे 23 cm, 26 cm और 39 cm की तीन छड़ों में से किसी से भी पूरा-पूरा मापा जा सके?
solutionHi: लंबाई हर एक की पूरी गुणज हो: सबसे कम LCM(23, 26, 39) = 1794 cm (17 m 94 cm)।

subject: Maths
question: Three people walk with steps of 51 cm, 54 cm and 72 cm respectively. What is the least distance each of them can cover in a whole number of steps?
solution: The length must be a whole number of each: the least is LCM(51, 54, 72) = 3672 cm (36 m 72 cm).
questionHi: तीन व्यक्तियों के एक कदम की लंबाई क्रमशः 51 cm, 54 cm और 72 cm है। वह न्यूनतम दूरी कितनी है जिसे उनमें से प्रत्येक पूरे-पूरे कदमों में तय कर सके?
solutionHi: लंबाई हर एक की पूरी गुणज हो: सबसे कम LCM(51, 54, 72) = 3672 cm (36 m 72 cm)।

subject: Maths
question: The LCM of two numbers is 286. Which of the following can never be their HCF?
solution: The HCF divides both numbers, and the LCM is a multiple of both, so the HCF always divides the LCM. 286 ÷ 176 is not a whole number, while 286 ÷ 143 = 2, 286 ÷ 22 = 13, 286 ÷ 11 = 26. So 176 can never be the HCF.
questionHi: दो संख्याओं का LCM 286 है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कभी उनका HCF नहीं हो सकता?
solutionHi: HCF दोनों संख्याओं को विभाजित करता है और LCM दोनों का गुणज है, अतः HCF सदा LCM को विभाजित करता है। 286 ÷ 176 पूर्ण संख्या नहीं, जबकि 286 ÷ 143 = 2, 286 ÷ 22 = 13, 286 ÷ 11 = 26। अतः 176 कभी HCF नहीं हो सकता।

subject: Maths
question: A shopkeeper has 52 litres, 156 litres and 338 litres of three kinds of oil. He fills them, without mixing, into tins of one size so that every tin is full. What is the least number of tins he needs?
solution: Fewest tins means the biggest tin: HCF(52, 156, 338) = 26 litres. Tins = 52 ÷ 26 + 156 ÷ 26 + 338 ÷ 26 = 2 + 6 + 13 = 21.
questionHi: एक दुकानदार के पास तीन प्रकार का तेल क्रमशः 52 लीटर, 156 लीटर और 338 लीटर है। वह इन्हें बिना मिलाए एक ही आकार के डिब्बों में भरता है ताकि हर डिब्बा पूरा भरा हो। उसे कम से कम कितने डिब्बे चाहिए?

subject: Maths
question: Three bells start ringing together and ring at intervals of 10, 15 and 16 seconds respectively. How many times will they ring together in 1 hour, counting the time they start?
solution: LCM(10, 15, 16) = 240 seconds, so they ring together every 4 minutes. In 1 hour = 3600 seconds that is 3600 ÷ 240 = 15 times after the start, and 1 more at the start: 16.
questionHi: तीन घंटियाँ एक साथ बजना शुरू करती हैं और क्रमशः 10, 15 और 16 सेकंड के अंतराल पर बजती हैं। 1 घंटे में वे कितनी बार एक साथ बजेंगी (आरंभ वाली बार सहित)?
solutionHi: LCM(10, 15, 16) = 240 सेकंड, अतः वे हर 4 मिनट पर साथ बजती हैं। 1 घंटे = 3600 सेकंड में आरंभ के बाद 3600 ÷ 240 = 15 बार, और 1 बार आरंभ में: 16।

subject: Maths
question: How many common factors do 344 and 1290 have?
solution: The common factors of two numbers are the factors of their HCF. HCF(344, 1290) = 86 = 2 × 43, whose factors are 1, 2, 43, 86: 4 in all (1 and 86 included).
questionHi: 344 और 1290 के कितने उभयनिष्ठ गुणनखंड हैं?
solutionHi: दो संख्याओं के उभयनिष्ठ गुणनखंड उनके HCF के गुणनखंड होते हैं। HCF(344, 1290) = 86 = 2 × 43, जिसके गुणनखंड 1, 2, 43, 86 हैं: कुल 4 (1 और 86 सहित)।

subject: Maths
question: What is the least number of students who can stand in rows of 8, 15 and 20 each, with no one left over whichever row size is used?
solution: The number must divide exactly by each row size: the least is LCM(8, 15, 20) = 120.
questionHi: विद्यार्थियों की वह न्यूनतम संख्या क्या है जिन्हें 8, 15 और 20 की पंक्तियों में खड़ा किया जा सके, चाहे कोई भी पंक्ति-आकार लें, कोई न बचे?
solutionHi: संख्या हर पंक्ति-आकार से पूरी विभाज्य हो: सबसे छोटी LCM(8, 15, 20) = 120।

subject: Maths
question: What is the greatest number that divides both 132 and 168 exactly?
solution: The greatest number dividing both exactly is their HCF. 132 = 2² × 3 × 11, 168 = 2³ × 3 × 7, so the HCF is 12. Check: 132 ÷ 12 = 11 and 168 ÷ 12 = 14.
questionHi: वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है जिससे 132 और 168 दोनों पूरी तरह विभाजित हो जाते हैं?

subject: Maths
question: Find the HCF of 108 and 180.
solution: 108 = 2² × 3³, 180 = 2² × 3² × 5. The common prime factors, each with its lower power: 2² × 3² = 36. So the HCF is 36.
questionHi: 108 और 180 का HCF (महत्तम समापवर्तक) क्या है?
solutionHi: 108 = 2² × 3³, 180 = 2² × 3² × 5। उभयनिष्ठ अभाज्य गुणनखंड, प्रत्येक अपनी छोटी घात के साथ: 2² × 3² = 36। अतः HCF = 36।

subject: Maths
question: A room is 516 cm long and 215 cm wide. Its floor is to be covered with square tiles, all of the same size, without cutting any tile. What is the side of the largest tile that can be used?
solution: The tile side must divide both the length and the width: the largest is HCF(516, 215) = 43 cm.
questionHi: एक कमरा 516 cm लंबा और 215 cm चौड़ा है। इसके फ़र्श पर एक ही आकार की वर्गाकार टाइलें बिना काटे लगानी हैं। सबसे बड़ी संभव टाइल की भुजा कितनी होगी?
solutionHi: टाइल की भुजा लंबाई और चौड़ाई दोनों को विभाजित करे: सबसे बड़ी HCF(516, 215) = 43 cm।

subject: Maths
question: 22 pencils, 110 erasers and 143 notebooks are to be shared among the greatest possible number of children so that each child gets the same number of each item, with nothing left over. How many children can there be at most?
solution: Each item must split equally, so the number of children divides every count; the greatest is HCF(22, 110, 143) = 11.
questionHi: 22 पेंसिलें, 110 रबड़ और 143 कॉपियाँ को अधिक से अधिक बच्चों में इस प्रकार बाँटना है कि हर बच्चे को हर वस्तु समान संख्या में मिले और कुछ न बचे। अधिक से अधिक कितने बच्चे हो सकते हैं?
solutionHi: हर वस्तु बराबर बँटे, अतः बच्चों की संख्या हर गिनती को विभाजित करे; सबसे बड़ी HCF(22, 110, 143) = 11।

subject: Maths
question: Find the HCF of 40, 160 and 180.
solution: 40 = 2³ × 5, 160 = 2⁵ × 5, 180 = 2² × 3² × 5. Only the primes common to all 3 numbers count, each with its lowest power: 2² × 5 = 20. (40 and 160 alone have HCF 40, but 180 does not share all of it.)
questionHi: 40, 160 और 180 का HCF ज्ञात कीजिए।

subject: Maths
question: 240 erasers, 300 notebooks and 330 bananas are to be shared among the greatest possible number of children so that each child gets the same number of each item, with nothing left over. How many bananas does each child get?
solution: The number of children is the HCF: HCF(240, 300, 330) = 30. Each child gets 330 ÷ 30 = 11 bananas.
questionHi: 240 रबड़, 300 कॉपियाँ और 330 केले को अधिक से अधिक बच्चों में इस प्रकार बाँटना है कि हर बच्चे को हर वस्तु समान संख्या में मिले और कुछ न बचे। हर बच्चे को कितने केले मिलेंगे?

subject: Maths
question: Which of the following numbers is co-prime to 88?
solution: Two numbers are co-prime when their HCF is 1. 88 = 2³ × 11. 90 shares 2, 92 shares 4, 94 shares 2; 91 = 7 × 13 shares no prime with 88, so HCF(88, 91) = 1.
questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी संख्या 88 के साथ सह-अभाज्य (co-prime) है?
solutionHi: दो संख्याएँ सह-अभाज्य होती हैं जब उनका HCF 1 हो। 88 = 2³ × 11। 90 में 2 उभयनिष्ठ है, 92 में 4 उभयनिष्ठ है, 94 में 2 उभयनिष्ठ है; 91 = 7 × 13 में 88 का कोई अभाज्य नहीं, अतः HCF(88, 91) = 1।

subject: Maths
question: The HCF of two numbers is 26 and their LCM is 3042. If one of the numbers is 234, what is the other?
solution: HCF × LCM = product of the two numbers: 26 × 3042 = 234 × other. Other = 79092 ÷ 234 = 338. (Check: HCF(234, 338) = 26.)
questionHi: दो संख्याओं का HCF 26 और LCM 3042 है। यदि एक संख्या 234 है, तो दूसरी संख्या क्या है?

subject: Maths
question: What is the LCM of 2⁴ × 3 and 2² × 3³ × 7?
solution: Take every prime that appears in either, each with its higher power: 2⁴ × 3³ × 7 = 3024.
questionHi: 2⁴ × 3 और 2² × 3³ × 7 का LCM क्या है?
solutionHi: किसी में भी आने वाला हर अभाज्य, अपनी बड़ी घात के साथ: 2⁴ × 3³ × 7 = 3024।

subject: Maths
question: Find the least 4-digit number which is exactly divisible by 6, 16 and 25.
solution: LCM(6, 16, 25) = 1200. The least 4-digit number is 1000; 1000 ÷ 1200 leaves 1000, so the least multiple of 1200 that is 4 digits long is 1000 + (1200 − 1000) = 1200. The answer is 1200.
questionHi: चार अंकों की वह सबसे छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 6, 16 और 25 से पूरी तरह विभाज्य है।

subject: Maths
question: Two numbers are in the ratio 9 : 10 and their LCM is 1260. What is their HCF?
solution: The numbers are 9k and 10k; 9 and 10 are co-prime, so HCF = k and LCM = 9 × 10 × k = 90k. 90k = 1260 gives k = 14. The HCF is 14 (numbers 126 and 140).
questionHi: दो संख्याएँ 9 : 10 के अनुपात में हैं और उनका LCM 1260 है। उनका HCF क्या है?
solutionHi: संख्याएँ 9k और 10k हैं; 9 और 10 सह-अभाज्य हैं, अतः HCF = k और LCM = 9 × 10 × k = 90k। 90k = 1260 से k = 14। HCF = 14 (संख्याएँ 126 और 140)।

subject: Maths
question: Three bells ring at intervals of 20, 21 and 28 seconds respectively. If they ring together at 2:00:00 PM, at what time will they next ring together?
solution: LCM(20, 21, 28) = 420 seconds = 7 minutes. 2:00:00 PM + 7 minutes = 2:07:00 PM.
questionHi: तीन घंटियाँ क्रमशः 20, 21 और 28 सेकंड के अंतराल पर बजती हैं। यदि वे 2:00:00 PM पर एक साथ बजीं, तो अगली बार वे एक साथ कब बजेंगी?

subject: Maths
question: Three lights flash at intervals of 6, 11 and 15 seconds respectively. If they flash together now, after how many seconds will they next flash together?
solution: They are together again after a time that is a multiple of every interval - the least is the LCM. 6 = 2 × 3, 11 = 11, 15 = 3 × 5, so LCM(6, 11, 15) = 330 seconds.
questionHi: तीन बत्तियाँ क्रमशः 6, 11 और 15 सेकंड के अंतराल पर चमकती हैं। यदि वे अभी एक साथ चमकती हैं, तो कितने सेकंड बाद वे फिर एक साथ चमकेंगी?
solutionHi: वे फिर उस समय साथ होंगी जो हर अंतराल का गुणज हो - सबसे कम LCM है। 6 = 2 × 3, 11 = 11, 15 = 3 × 5, अतः LCM(6, 11, 15) = 330 सेकंड।

subject: Maths
question: Three rods are 72 cm, 288 cm and 312 cm long. They are to be cut into pieces all of the same length, with nothing left over. What is the greatest possible length of each piece?
solution: The piece must divide every length exactly; the longest is HCF(72, 288, 312) = 24 cm.
questionHi: तीन छड़ों की लंबाई क्रमशः 72 cm, 288 cm और 312 cm है। इन्हें बिना कुछ बचे एक ही लंबाई के टुकड़ों में काटना है। हर टुकड़े की अधिकतम लंबाई कितनी हो सकती है?
solutionHi: टुकड़ा हर लंबाई को पूरा विभाजित करे; सबसे लंबा HCF(72, 288, 312) = 24 cm।

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest number which, when increased by 14, is exactly divisible by 8, 12 and 27?
solution: The number + 14 must be a common multiple; the least is LCM(8, 12, 27) = 216. So the number is 216 − 14 = 202.

question: Find the greatest 4-digit number which is exactly divisible by 5, 12 and 32.

question: Three bells ring at intervals of 6, 21 and 51 seconds respectively. If they ring together now, after how many seconds will they next ring together?

question: Find the greatest 4-digit number which is exactly divisible by 8, 9 and 14.

question: Three friends visit the market every 6, 8 and 15 days respectively. They all visited it today. After how many days will they next visit it on the same day?

question: Buses on three routes leave a depot every 6, 8 and 33 minutes respectively. If buses on all three routes leave together at 9:45 AM, at what time will they next leave together?

question: What is the least number that must be subtracted from 77701 so that the result is exactly divisible by 4, 7 and 22?

question: A room is 1275 cm long and 867 cm wide. Its floor is to be covered with square tiles, all of the same size, without cutting any tile. What is the least number of tiles needed?

question: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 9 and their LCM is 315. What is their HCF?
solution: The numbers are 5k and 9k; 5 and 9 are co-prime, so HCF = k and LCM = 5 × 9 × k = 45k. 45k = 315 gives k = 7. The HCF is 7 (numbers 35 and 63).

question: Three containers hold 162 litres, 486 litres and 594 litres of juice respectively. What is the largest measuring jar that can measure the juice of each container exactly?

question: The HCF of two numbers is 12. Which of the following can never be their LCM?

question: What is the least number, other than 8, which when divided by 20, 21 and 28 leaves a remainder of 8 in each case?

question: 186 pencils, 372 erasers and 403 notebooks are to be shared among the greatest possible number of children so that each child gets the same number of each item, with nothing left over. How many notebooks does each child get?
